description.value: Curbside Cookhouse is a local takeout operation in Merritt, BC, built around a curbside-pickup model with online ordering through Square. The menu leans into taco-style offerings, with a recurring Taco Tuesday promotion. For touring cyclists passing through the Nicola Valley, it offers a quick, casual meal stop in the heart of Merritt.
